name: ljosalfar_archer
description: a Ljosalfar Archer (Fall from Heaven), a young elf woman with long blonde hair and a pointed ear: a green tunic and short green cloak with gold leaf trim, a brown belt, cream leggings, tall brown boots, a quiver of white-fletched arrows on her back on the screen-left side, and a golden longbow held out in her LEFT hand with an arrow nocked and drawn back to her cheek by her RIGHT hand
hands: the golden longbow stays in her left hand on the screen-right side, held out at arm's length; her right hand on the screen-left side draws the string and arrow back to her cheek

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (her right hand flung out to the left, still clutching the arrow, the bow arm thrown up and out with the golden longbow upright), long blonde hair flying
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the golden longbow dipping, her right hand still held out with the arrow

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, bow arm flung up with the golden longbow upright, the arrow falling from her right hand
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the golden longbow lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, one end of the golden longbow resting on the ground at the lower-right, her right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the golden longbow slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the green cloak flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, long blonde hair spread on the ground; the golden longbow lies on the ground at the lower-right; the quiver under her shoulders, a few arrows spilled
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hair and green cloak settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the golden longbow on the ground beside her
